brief: Copy pass, 2026-11-26: plain headings, from the lab to the sales floor, On-Sight case study. docs/briefs/copy-pass-2026-11-26.md
note: Only passes and evidence change. A line passes only with quoted evidence from this session.

lines.line: When npm run check runs, then lint, brand guard and build exit 0.
lines.evidence: 2026-11-26 final run: lint 0 errors, 1 warning in src/lib/api-route-helpers.ts (a file this change does not touch); 'Brand guard passed: baseline reference + approved exceptions are intact.'; 'Compiled successfully'; 'Generating static pages using 3 workers (29/29)'; route list includes /case-studies/on-sight-safety-optics.

lines.line: When each page is fetched, then there is one h1, the Home h1 is exactly "Marketing For Independent Optical Practices", and no h1 is longer than 8 words.
lines.evidence: pagecheck.mjs on all 13 routes: no 'h1 count' or 'h1 >8 words' failure. Home h1: 'Marketing For Independent Optical Practices'. Others: 'Optical Marketing For Independent Practices', 'Optical Marketing Services', 'The SCALE Method', 'Hi, I'm Jonathan Mejia', 'Tell Me About Your Practice', 'On-Sight Safety Optics Case Study'.

lines.line: When headings on Home, Optical, Services, Method, About and the case study are listed, then every h2 is 10 words or fewer and in Title Case.
lines.evidence: pagecheck.mjs: no 'h2 >10 words' failure. The only 'not Title Case' hit on any route is the visually hidden footer landmark heading 'Site footer' (pre-existing, not copy). Method h2s 'S : Study The Market' etc. pass.

lines.line: When src is scanned, then zero U+2014 and U+2013, no not-X-but-Y or not-just patterns in copy, no San Diego or Google Business Profile or near me outside src/app/terms/page.tsx, and CTAs in Title Case.
lines.proved_by: copy scan script (new, scratchpad) plus grep output
lines.evidence: copyscan.mjs self-test on a bad file: 5 hits (em dash, San Diego, near me, not-X-but-Y, Google Business Profile). Real src (45 files in copy scope): 1 hit, a code comment in src/lib/site.ts:39 explaining why San Diego was dropped (not user-facing). CTA labels checked by eye in the screenshots: Book A Free Call, See How I Work, Read The Case Study, Read My Story.

lines.line: When Home, Optical and About are fetched, then each carries the phrase "lab to the sales floor".
lines.evidence: Re-run after the full rewrite (2026-11-26), misc.mjs on the production build: 'phrase on / true', 'phrase on /about true', 'phrase on /optical-marketing true'.

lines.line: When the diff of src/content is read, then every fact about Jonathan or On-Sight matches section 4 of the brief, and every number is On-Sight's published figure, attributed and dated.
lines.proved_by: fresh checker plus grep of digits in the diff
lines.evidence: After the checker-fix batch, git diff -U0 of src/content and site.ts was grepped for digits and bio facts: every bio fact (lab, machinery repair, LensCrafters, Site for Sore Eyes, UC Riverside, MBA) is one Jonathan stated, and every number is 90 (monthly report and review he confirmed) or 60 (FAQ word limit). onsight.ts digits all carry source and asOf. numcheck.mjs: case study numbers match onsight.ts rows, only unmatched token is the phone number. The Sonnet checker read 14 copy files BEFORE the fix batch and did not read onsight.ts, so this is a self-read of the final diff, not an independent one.

lines.line: When each FAQ list is read, then every answer is 60 words or fewer, opens with the direct answer, and the FAQPage JSON-LD text equals the visible text.
lines.evidence: pagecheck.mjs: no 'faq >60 words' and no 'faq text not visible verbatim' failure on Home, Optical, Services.

lines.line: When page source is read for all routes, then titles are 60 characters or fewer, descriptions 50 to 155, unique, JSON-LD present, no LocalBusiness.
lines.evidence: pagecheck.mjs: no title, desc, dup or LocalBusiness failure. Longest title 60 (Optical), longest description 155 (case study).

lines.line: When the case study page is opened at 375 and 1440, then no horizontal scroll, one h1, a call to action in the first screen, WebPage and Breadcrumb JSON-LD with About pointing at an On-Sight Organization node.
lines.evidence: scrollshot.mjs: d1440 overflowX false h1 1; m375 overflowX false h1 1. misc.mjs: WebPage node with about -> .../on-sight-safety-optics#organization, Organization 'On-Sight Safety Optics', BreadcrumbList present. Re-run after the full rewrite: scrollshot.mjs gave d1440 overflowX false h1 1 and m375 overflowX false h1 1 again, and the screenshots (scratchpad pw/shots/rw-case/d1440-top.png and m375-top.png) show the hero 'Book A Free Call' button inside the first screen at both widths. After the case study rework (new sections), scrollshot.mjs on the production build at port 3200 gave d1440 overflowX false h1 1 and m375 overflowX false h1 1; screenshots in scratchpad pw/shots/cs-rework show the hero button in the first screen at both widths. misc.mjs on that build: WebPage about -> #organization, Organization and BreadcrumbList present; the page HTML holds datePublished and dateModified 2026-11-26 (toggle.mjs).

lines.line: When onSightApproved is false in a scratch build, then no page contains "On-Sight", the case study route is 404 and the sitemap omits it. When true, the page and sitemap entry appear.
lines.evidence: Build with onSightApproved=false, served on a scratch port: 'case study status: 404 | 404 page mentions On-Sight in text/title: false'; 11 routes incl. / /about /optical-marketing /services /method /contact /insights /book /privacy /terms /sitemap.xml all 'clean'; 'visible leaks: 0'. Limit: a client JS chunk still holds the string 'On-Sight Safety Optics' (unused constant bundled with site.ts); no page text, RSC payload or sitemap holds it. With true: case study in sitemap true, page 200.

lines.line: When the Insights drafts are checked, then all stay published:false, noindex and absent from the sitemap.
lines.evidence: pagecheck.mjs: 'drafts in sitemap: false'. misc.mjs: draft route status 404 on the production build; /insights robots 'noindex, follow'.

lines.line: Before any push, On-Sight has agreed to be named.
After the build, Jonathan reads the new Home, About, Optical and case study copy and says it sounds like him.
lines.proved_by: owner-run: his reply or his edits quoted

lines.line: When the case study page text is scanned for digits, then every number on it is a row in the figures table in src/content/onsight.ts with a source (on-sight-published, ga4 or jonathan) and an asOf date.
lines.evidence: Re-run after the full rewrite, same result. Re-run after the case study rework (2026-11-26, new Challenge and Glance sections): numcheck.mjs tokens 98% 47 2026 93 26 18% 37% 254 276 8 2 10 15% $100000+ 9 40+ 6500+ 3 265 $100000 916 520 4553; the new 265 matches the totalBefore row (source ga4, asOf 2026-11-26); 'UNMATCHED: 916 520 4553' which is the phone number in the call band (the script flags any digit string outside the table, so it does fail on non-table numbers).

lines.line: When the two flags are toggled in a scratch build (4 combinations), then onSightApproved false shows no "On-Sight" anywhere, a 404 route and no sitemap entry; onSightApproved true with onSightFiguresApproved false shows the work and the +98% but none of +8, +2, 10-15% or $100,000.
lines.evidence: Ran 3 of 4: (true,true) shows +98%, +8, Yelp, 10 to 15%, $100,000 in the case study files; (false,true) shows none of the five and no sitemap entry (see A-10); (true,false) shows +98% in 8 files and 0 files with +8, Yelp, 10 to 15% or $100,000. (false,false) not run: it is the same code path as (false,true) because onSightApproved is checked first. Re-run after the case study rework (2026-11-26): scratch build with onSightFiguresApproved=false and VERCEL_ENV=production (flag restored, confirmed by grep of onsight.ts lines 19 and 27 both true). toggle.mjs on that build: (LATER CHANGE 2026-11-26: the 10 to 15% and $100,000+ rows were removed and replaced by the pricing rows pricingAccounts 40, pricingBefore $2,500 to $3,000, pricingAfter $3,000 to $5,000, so the pricing check is now those rows, still behind the figures switch; the review figures are +35% and +50%, so check those instead of +8 and +2; the toggle test was not re-run after this change) absent are +8, Yelp, 10 to 15%, $100,000, 'Pricing was scattered', 'review counts, the pricing change', 'Reported Figures', 'not independently documented'; present are +98% and 265; Challenge shows 2 items, Limitations 5 items. With both flags true on the real build: all of those present, Challenge 3 items, Limitations 6 items.

lines.line: When the diff and docs/briefs/onsight-evidence-2026-11-26.md are scanned, then no name, email, phone or message from any form or order, and no group under 5.
lines.proved_by: grep of the diff and the note
lines.evidence: Re-run after the full rewrite: Grep for email addresses and phone numbers over docs/briefs and src/content returned no matches in either folder. No Supabase rows were read in this work.

lines.line: When the case study is read, then review gains appear as he stated them with no invented dates, and a percentage appears only with the before and after totals he supplied.
lines.proved_by: diff read by the fresh checker
lines.evidence: UPDATED 2026-11-26 (later): Jonathan gave the totals now (Google 31, Yelp 6) and asked for percentages. Before totals are those minus his stated gains (23 and 4), so +35% (8 of 23, 34.8 rounded) and +50% (2 of 4). Rows googleBefore, googleAfter, yelpBefore, yelpAfter, googleReviews, yelpReviews in onsight.ts, source jonathan, asOf 2026-11-26, labeled 'Confirmed by On-Sight's owner'. Page text check on the built page: +35%, +50%, 'from 23 to 31', 'from 4 to 6' and 'Both percentages rest on small review counts' present; '+8' and '+2' absent; numcheck matches 35% 23 31 50% 4 6 to table rows. No dates invented ('in the past few months'). Earlier read follows. Read by me, src/content/onsight.ts lines 83-96 (figure rows) and 229-250 (caseStudyChanged, after the 2026-11-26 rework): review gains are '+8' Google and '+2' Yelp, noted 'Added in the past few months', source 'jonathan' (label now "Author's account"), no month or year given, no percentage. A fresh checker did not read onsight.ts, so this is a self-read.
